roadmap_title: Mastery Roadmap: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Engineer (6 Months)

phases_summary.focus: Syntax, core programming, computer science principles & version control
Essential domain libraries, relational databases, data pipelines & algorithms
Specialized frameworks, architecture design, cloud deployment & optimization
End-to-end capstone systems, production CI/CD, documentation & testing
Technical interviews, LeetCode problem solving, resume refinement & mock interviews

timeline.title: Core Foundations & Tooling
action_items: Master advanced Python fundamentals: decorators, generators, and object-oriented design.
Review linear algebra & matrix operations with NumPy and vectorization exercises.
Set up Git, GitHub repository workflow, and clean virtual environment isolation.
Solve 20 practice algorithmic problems on arrays, dictionaries, and string manipulation.
timeline.project_outcome: CLI Numerical Matrix Engine & Algorithmic Problem Solver

timeline.title: Core Domain Systems & Data Pipelines
action_items: Master exploratory data analysis (EDA) with Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
Write complex SQL queries (multi-table JOINs, Window functions, aggregations) for analytics.
Clean, impute, and preprocess real-world tabular datasets from Kaggle.
Build statistical hypotheses testing and correlation analysis pipelines.
timeline.project_outcome: Interactive Exploratory Data Analytics Dashboard on Real-World Datasets

timeline.title: Advanced Frameworks & Architecture
action_items: Implement classical machine learning algorithms from scratch: Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees.
Master Scikit-learn pipelines: Feature scaling, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning (GridSearchCV).
Study model evaluation metrics: ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall, F1-Score, and Confusion Matrix.
Deploy a trained Scikit-learn classification model via a lightweight FastAPI REST microservice.
timeline.project_outcome: End-to-End Machine Learning Prediction Web Service with Live Scoring

timeline.title: Comprehensive Capstone Portfolio Project
action_items: Deep dive into Neural Networks and Deep Learning using PyTorch.
Train convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for vision or fine-tune Transformers with Hugging Face.
Implement MLOps practices: Model tracking with MLflow/Weights & Biases and Dockerized inference.
Package the solution with an interactive Streamlit UI and comprehensive documentation.
timeline.project_outcome: Production-Grade AI Capstone System with PyTorch, MLOps Tracking & Streamlit UI

timeline.title: Technical Interviews & Placement Preparation
action_items: Complete targeted LeetCode Top 75 / Blind 75 questions (Focus on Graphs, DP, Trees).
Practice mock technical interviews with peers or platforms like Pramp / Interviewing.io.
Format resume using standard single-page tech format highlighting measurable project impacts.
Draft clear answers to behavioral questions using the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) method.
timeline.project_outcome: Polished Industry Resume, Portfolio Website, and Interview Preparation Notes

timeline.title: Internship Outreach & Job Placement Drives
action_items: Apply to 20-30 curated internship and junior engineering openings across LinkedIn, Wellfound, and campus drives.
Engage in targeted professional outreach to hiring managers and tech alumni.
Complete company take-home coding assessments and system architecture design challenges.
Conduct continuous mock HR and managerial interviews to master salary and offer negotiation.
timeline.project_outcome: Active Placement Pipeline & Internship / Junior Role Offers
